The audit is done: an Opus Explore agent, finished 12:20 CST (coordinator). It found 5 gaps, and each one now has a home.
1. Merges through the GitHub MCP tool skip every merge check. settings.json has had no guard entry for mcp__github__* since commit 97ffeb3f (Oct 2), measured. A lane is fixing it now (step mcp-merge-unguarded).
2. Whether a merge counts as a guard or check change is the author's word. merge.py should work it out from the changed paths (step merge-guard-flag-from-paths). Refusing a merge with no record would go against your item 113 a, so that half comes back to you as a question later.
3. A broken state file (inbox, handoff, roadmap JSON) is not caught when it is written (step state-file-parse-check).
4. A step can be marked done with no check behind it, and a plan brief can skip its critic (step step-done-needs-check).
5. Claims that only you can do something, outside GitHub, are part of step prose-governance-workflow.
